paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
notes: This paper identifies an ALLOWED (favored) region in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane rather than an exclusion limit. The region solving the CIB/TeV tension is m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV and g_agamma between 1.5e-11 and 8.8e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. (from combined H2356-309 and 1ES1101-232 fits, CIBER + Franceschini-Th data). The values given are the corner bounds of the allowed contour, not a continuous exclusion curve. The CAST bound (8.8e-11 GeV^-1) provides an external upper limit. Points encode the diagonal extent of the favored region; not a standard exclusion curve, hence lower confidence. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.5, 2))
